entries.note: Independent audit 2026-11-23 of all 6 keys of wire.ask_receipts in zh-CN against en source 1ae74bc10135dee17828f58af819fc521bd1e15024b3ce466cca20e49e102507 and sidecar 48222d4c8f3d776444973f6e4b1bfc5052552dada49708c06c7faa0e53e78dfa; target a0177717f0ce4fbf20f3b310020c9df6c1931c0530dfab1c070dbe4c01cbf1a1 recomputed from the file after the audit edits. Method: read docs/I18N.md, glossary, the locale style guide and the sidecar; compared with the shipped relay.ask / relay.asks sibling renderings of the same states; rendered every key with local_operator.i18n.messages.render for surface remote/tui/chat/desktop/other x reason answered_in_chat/moot/absent/unknown and waited 45s/3h/42m; checked placeholder and ICU select arm parity, NFC, no manual bidi controls, no English word inside a translated sentence, and cell widths against maxCells. Edits by the auditor (translator of record unchanged): response.dismissed: ASCII `, ` between the two select groups -> full-width `，`; timeout.timed_out: `{waited} 后` -> `{waited}后` (no space between Latin token and CJK). Pre-audit target sha256 6e91f615c3381d7d7cf4f955751680b897f22a7a674bbd205b54bf4659bbe967. Findings: [minor, fixed] response.dismissed joined the surface and reason clauses with an ASCII comma+space; zh-CN style guide requires full-width ，and no space beside CJK in prose. Changed to `，`. | [minor, fixed] timeout.timed_out put a space between the Latin/digit {waited} token and 后; the style guide forbids spaces between CJK and Latin/digit runs. Removed. Evidence is this auditor's own command output in the lane session, not an external report.
